correctness.rationale: The exact source defining-zero set \(R=\{0,1,2,3,4,5,6,8,9,12\}\) is reconstructed in an explicit order-\(15\) root model over \(\mathbb F_{16}\). The resulting degree-ten polynomial has coefficients in \(\mathbb F_4\), divides \(x^{15}-1\), and its five shifts have rank \(5\) and zero Euclidean Gram matrix. Enumeration of all \(1024\) words gives minimum weight \(8\), matching the published parameter. Unique RREF enumeration gives \(341,5797,5797,341,1\) message subspaces in dimensions \(1,\ldots,5\). For each basis the union of its codeword supports is exactly the support of the generated subcode, so the exhaustive \(12277\)-subspace census proves every claimed multiplicity and generalized-weight minimum.

value.rationale: The source highlights this q=4,m=2 member as an optimal self-orthogonal cyclic code, while publishing only minimum-distance-level information. The complete SSWD is the natural all-dimensional refinement: it determines every generalized Hamming weight, every extremal multiplicity, and every nonminimal support layer across all 12277 subcodes. This supplies a complete higher-support fingerprint for a newly published optimal cyclic construction and can distinguish it from parameter-matching codes whose ordinary and higher support geometry differs.
